Locked test passes in both browsers (x3) covering cases (1)-(5); case (5) runs on the real clock because Playwright's fake clock reuses performance.timeOrigin. Holdout (real clock): reload on the Table, Resume (history key differs from the pre-reload key), Back opens Home focused with Resume, further Backs never reopen the Table and reach about:blank. Holdout (fake clock): Leave table steps history back to state null; Resume then Back pauses to Home; Forward ignored; Resume again and keyboard Enter on Home pauses; repeated Back leaves the app without reopening the Table -> PASS. On substance the key is unique across real loads; the fake-clock collision is a test-environment artefact only.
